title: Natural lift of system tensor evaluation to finite constructible objects
statement: For d,m as in [def-sf-integral-projection-finite-evaluation-data], invertible coefficient prime hl, and any SystemTensorEvaluation b of [def-sf-integral-projection-evaluation-factors], construct liftedTensorEvaluation d m hl b : TensorComparison d m. For every integral constructible K,L on X, evaluate datumTensorReduction, then b at the reduced systems, then tensor the two reductionEvaluation comparisons. This composite equals reductionEvaluation at the datum tensor followed by the finite inclusion applied to the corresponding liftedTensorEvaluation component. The comparison is natural in both inputs and is constructed from b by cancellation of the full finite inclusion.

proof.text: Use the currying counit to identify the included finite partial tensor with the ambient transported tensor. Cancel the full and faithful finite inclusion to construct liftedTensorEvaluation. Its image is the explicit comparison by map_preimage. Cancel the adjacent reductionEvaluation hom and inverse to obtain liftedTensorEvaluation_square. The two partialTensor_map lemmas compute morphisms in either input under inclusion directly from the lift and currying definitions; the main proof can therefore keep partialTensor abstract during elaboration.

theorem liftedTensorEvaluation_square (hl : IsUnit (C.l : D.k))
    (b : SystemTensorEvaluation (C := C) (E := E) m) (X : SixFunctorSpace D)
    (K L : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E X.obj.left) :
    (evaluation (C := C) (E := E) m X).map
        (FixProjectionCompactification.Coordinates.datumTensorReduction
          D C E d.higher hl X K L).hom ≫
      (b X).hom.app ((calculus C.l E X.obj.left).reduction.obj K.obj,
        (calculus C.l E X.obj.left).reduction.obj L.obj) ≫
      (evaluatedTensor (C := C) (E := E) m X).map
        (Prod.mkHom (reductionEvaluation d m X K).hom (reductionEvaluation d m X L).hom) =
    (reductionEvaluation d m X (((d.higher.integralTensor X).obj K).obj L)).hom ≫
      (finiteInclusion (C := C) (E := E) m X).map
        ((tensorCoordinates d m (liftedTensorEvaluation d m hl b)) X K L).hom
